notes.title: Patch Notes v2.0.0.7
notes.notes:
-Added more mushroom spawns
-Added quest filter to allow filtering quests by all, daily, faction, etc.
-Added new weapons
-Added new blueprints
-Added Scroll of Town Portal
-Added the option to teleport to the guild city from the battlemaster in Schimmerstein City
-Increased the number of spawned monsters on the island
-Increased the chance of higher evolution monsters spawning
-Increased the gain chance for several abilities
-Improved food buffs: higher quality food now provides better buffs
-Improved the knockback mechanic
-Updated some quest dialogs
-Enhanced the karma system: using necromancer spells results in losing karma, while supporting other players with sanctummancy spells increases karma
-Strengthened all monster bosses (e.g., dragon, wraith, orc)
-Placed all bosses in their own instances
-Opened a new area
-Renamed the rune 'Mastery' to 'Damage' to better indicate that it increases damage instead of skill power

Bugfixes
-Fixed an issue where players were unable to craft grenades at the workbench after learning the grenade blueprint (previously only possible at the alchemy table)
-Fixed a bug where MultipleShot required 9 arrows instead of 3
-Fixed an issue where players could apply damage to other players even when not in a faction
-Fixed a bug where chain lightning did not level up correctly
-Fixed an issue where some monsters spawned inside walls, especially on the island
-Fixed a bug where players could not plant seeds on others potting soil
-Fixed an issue where shields were not destroyed when reaching 0 durability
-Fixed server crashes that occurred after excessive use
-Fixed tooltip errors

Mechanics
-Added treasure map hunting
-Introduced a penalty system for deaths: losing 0.1 skill points and 1 ability point to deter fast city teleportation by death
-Added a new faction token system: players receive tokens for killing other faction players, and those killed lose tokens. Tokens can be used to purchase faction items. Players killed by another player can drop random loot (up to 5 items) per death, applicable only in faction areas and for faction players

notes.title: Developer Update 2023
notes.notes:
Greetings citizens of Gnome Online,

It's been a while around Gnome Online, which means I've been busy with the upcoming update. Below I would like to give you some information about what is coming and what are the next steps.

The big update is just around the corner. To prepare everything the server will be shut down next weekend (14.01.2023) and prepared for the wipe. During the following week the update will be installed. 

[b]On Thursday 19.01.2023 will be the fresh Start[/b]

-> Important info. For all old as well as new players who return until 31.01.2021 will receive a unique item.

[u][b]Upcoming Update[/b][/u]

[b]Auction house and Mailbox[/b]
The auction house has been reworked and finally implemented. Vallin Glitterhide in Schimmerstein will support you with your auctions. Purchased items can be picked up in your mailbox (left of the auction house).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42304071/c66d862fad05dc4b24cfba3983e1b9e280e5d1b8.png[/img]

[b]Bags[/b]
There are now finally bags, which can be equipped to expand the inventory. However, the main inventory (without bag) has been reduced by 5 slots.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42304071/b9a6ba2771e457d20f76afdc2941a123f64847d0.png[/img]

[b]World Events[/b]
There are now several fully automated world events that happen from time to time. There will be ingame notifications as well as Discord notifications (Discord notifications via Events -> Registration).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42304071/a529768a6440ecd1d167144df5a34c9ef8f8012c.png[/img]

[b]Instances[/b]
Instances have been added for a maximum group size of 5 players.
Instances work as follows. A group must be at the entrance of an instance. As soon as the leader enters the instance, all players are teleported. Re-entering the same instance after leaving is not possible. So think carefully about how you want to equip yourself in the group.
Additionally, a Need before Greed system has been introduced. This allows you to roll the dice for items in the group.

[b]Dismantling[/b]
The Dismantler in the city has been removed. Players can now dismantle items in their inventory at any time. This makes it easier to level crafting skills.

[b]Class system[/b]
A base/sub class system has been introduced. As before, you can level all skills. However, you must choose two classes to use at the same time. Changing classes is only possible in town.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42304071/518df3650793db531f7a94cf560b42703d09f130.png[/img]

[b]Fishing[/b]
The new Fishing feature has been implemented. With it you can catch fish in various places where there is water. These can then be cooked and eaten like meat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42304071/28259ae8cc099bd8a1ae21bc3591d1a59b4daec4.png[/img]

[b]Quality of Life[/b]
In the options it is now possible to reassign the keys according to your preferences. 


All other news can be found in the upcoming patch notes.
